name: Little Wolf River
gaugeName: LITTLE WOLF RIVER AT ROYALTON, WI
blurb: Upper Little Wolf trips from Wolf River Road through County J to the takeout above Big Falls, plus separately reviewed downstream access areas near Manawa and Royalton.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: County guide trip with Class II rapids. Suitable for paddlers with moving-water experience. Access-area markers and the dotted river overview do not identify an exact landing approach.

putInAccess.operator: Public access — managing agency not specified in county guide
putInAccess.sourceName: Visit Waupaca County — upper Little Wolf paddling map
putInAccess.note: The county map explicitly identifies a public access at this bridge. The approximate center was located from the guide’s road pattern and satellite imagery, not surveyed at the shoreline. County facility 9434 is a separate Norrin Road location downstream and is not the coordinate for this launch.
putInAccess.directions: Use the public Wolf River Road bridge access identified in the county paddling guide, near Norrin Road. The marker shows the crossing area; confirm the designated carry-in and parking on arrival.

takeOutAccess.operator: Public access — managing agency not specified in county guide
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Waupaca County — public access facilities and paddling guide
takeOutAccess.note: County paddling guide identifies this access between its two upper Little Wolf trips. County GIS places the point at the edge of the gravel access area northwest of the bridge. The bank connection is partly obscured; retain an approximate area instead of an exact landing pin.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the gravel public access area on the northwest side of County J bridge. Find the signed river approach on arrival; the marker identifies the access area.

sections.notes: The county guide flags the Dells and finishes this trip at Big Falls above the dam. Check conditions, scout the takeout before launching and do not continue over the dam or falls.

notices.title: Take out above Big Falls Dam
notices.text: Finish at the pond-side ramp before the dam. The downstream falls are outside this trip; no portage or continuous passage through them has been reviewed.

takeOutAccess.operator: Parks Department (ownership 'County' in the WDNR record)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: The unchanged Wisconsin DNR coordinate agrees with the county boat-launch record and the visible gravel ramp on the pond side of the dam. This is a desktop landing review, not a field survey. It is an above-dam takeout, not a launch for a continuous downstream trip through the falls.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the Big Falls Pond boat ramp on the pond side of the bridge and dam. This is the upstream takeout; stop here before the dam and falls.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Big Falls Pond Boat Ramp is above Big Falls Dam. A legal, usable route past the dam and falls is not established. The former Manawa millpond endpoint also needs a current landing review after the 2024 breach.
sections.routeReview: Do not plan this as a continuous float: Big Falls Dam separates the pond-side ramp from the downstream river, and the Manawa millpond was lost in 2024.

notices.title: Manawa millpond changed after the 2024 breach
notices.text: The City of Manawa’s July 2026 update describes continuing dam and millpond restoration planning. Older pond access and trip descriptions need a fresh review before use.
notices.sourceName: City of Manawa — dam restoration updates

gaugeContext.note: The Royalton station is downstream of the upper trips and the Big Falls and Manawa dam sites. Its readings provide conditions elsewhere on the Little Wolf, not a direct flow measurement or live duration for these upstream sections.
